improvements: My /try report, Step 3 chart (try-report-phone.png y≈3290-3420): when the bars are small or positive, the zero line runs straight through 'Vorsichtig 3 pro Tag', 'Erwartet 8 pro Tag' and 'Optimistisch 15 pro Tag'. The demo is fine only because its zero line sits further right (report-phone.png y≈3720-3920). Put the scenario labels in their own row that the axis does not cross: start the zero line below each label, or give the labels a background. Criterion: charts are readable at phone width. It worked when a zoom of the /try report chart (placeholder values) and of the demo chart shows no line through any text.

My /try report, Step 2 (try-report-phone.png y≈2180; try-report.txt:112-113): the heading 'VON WHAT-IF EINGESETZT: BITTE PRÜFEN (7)' sits above an empty box, which looks broken. Draw the seven rows under it, as the demo does for its one (report.txt:140-145): 'Startkosten 0,00 € · angenommen', 'Zusätzliche Personalstunden 0 · angenommen', and so on, each with an 'Ändern' link back to /try. Criterion: source chips make 'yours / a guess / filled in' obvious. It worked when the phone screenshot shows 7 rows under the heading.

After-test demo, 'Wo die Wirklichkeit gelandet ist' (report-result-phone.png y≈11380-11460): five labels are stacked over one short line. The tick for 'Trägt sich: 7' cuts through 'Erwartet: 8', and the guide line for 8 runs into 'Holt den Test herein: 11'. Put my three guesses (3, 8, 15) above the line and the two thresholds (7, 11) below it, as small flags. Or list them under the line ('Gemessen 6 · Trägt sich 7 · Erwartet 8 · Test herein 11'). Criterion: polish at phone width. It worked when a zoom at 390 px shows no tick or guide line crossing a label.

/try check page (try-phone-11.png, 4,300 px, about 5 phone screens): 11 'angenommen' rows, each with a big empty 'Ihre Zahl' box. Show assumed values as one line each, like 'Ihre Zahlen' above them ('Startkosten · 0,00 € · angenommen · Ändern'), and open the field only on tap. Put the ones that change the money most first (Startkosten, Personalstunden, Geld zum Entbehren). Criterion: the closed-beta flow can be finished alone, between customers. It worked when the check page fits in about 2 phone screens.

Frage 9 'Was kostet Sie der Test?' (try-phone-09.png): the hourly-cost field shows a grey '13,90' that looks filled in, while the other fields say 'z. B. 180', 'z. B. 1'. A blank field silently becomes 0 € (try-phone.txt:373). Use 'z. B.' in every placeholder, and under each empty field show what will be used ('Leer = 0 €', 'Leer = 13,90 € Mindestlohn'), or offer a '0 €' button. Criterion: one question per screen, no surprises. It worked when an empty Frage 9 shows on that screen what will be counted, before 'Weiter'.

The slider: red below zero, green above, the dot moves, and 'Warum sich das geändert hat' says each extra guest is worth 5,35 € × 10 = 53,50 €. wouldTry: yes, because I could do the whole thing on my phone between customers: code, 11 screens, my report, a rehearsal at the press of a button, and a test card I can print for the till. The only moment I slowed down was the long check page.
learnedAboutAI: The coloured labels still teach it best. Grey 'Berechnet' is plain arithmetic I can open. Yellow 'Eine Schätzung' is something only my test can answer. The orange 'Angenommen, bitte prüfen' box is what What-IF filled in for me. Pink 'Ausgedacht' is imagined guests, who never count in the money. 'Wer hat was gemacht?' sits at the top: 'Von einer KI: nichts' in my report, and in the Claude demo 'die ausgedachten Gäste gespielt … Gerechnet hat einfacher Code'.

Every number on screen is in German format ('9,90 €', '1.500 €', '−162 €', '36 %', '1.500,00 €' on the demo chips). '7 % · 19 %' now has the same spacing as everywhere else (landing-phone.png y≈2030). One line break separates '14,60' from '€' in the landing's flat-white card (landing-phone.png y≈11680). 'Probiert das Mittagsangebot' from Thanh to Fatima should be 'Probier'.
